title: Restore signed URL return semantics on getHtml/getImage and add readHtml/readImage for content

anchor.contextBefore: export class Screen extends GeneratedScreen implements ScreenContentSpec {

violation.problem: Screen.getHtml() and Screen.getImage() were repurposed to fetch content directly (HTML text and Uint8Array bytes), breaking 0.x code that expected signed download URLs.
violation.expectedSolution: Restore getHtml(): Promise<string> and getImage(): Promise<string> to return signed URLs (marked with @deprecated), keep getHtmlUrl() and getImageUrl(), and add readHtml(): Promise<string> and readImage(): Promise<Uint8Array> for content fetching.
